Daniel —

Thanks for the clear repro steps and the screenshot. I can see the interstitial in the shot; it does look like a redirect hop that's not forwarding the session cookie/RelayState. A couple of quick questions so we can narrow down:

- Are the affected users using the same browser + extensions? Any common corporate proxy?
- Can you paste the full invite URL (feel free to redact tenant ids) or share it over the support link if preferred?

I'll loop in Laura (on our integration team) and Ben (platform escalation) to validate whether our redirector (edge rewrite layer) is normalizing set-cookie headers. If we confirm a strip, we can request a short Ariba-side config change to preserve cookie attributes across the hop.

Proposed next step: Ben, can you run a quick capture on the last-hop response headers for tenant olive-001 and confirm whether SameSite/secure flags are being rewritten? If so, I'll open a case with Ariba support with the header traces.

Marcus

On Fri, Nov 13, 2026 at 10:02 AM Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Proposed next step: Ben, can you run a quick capture on the last-hop response headers for tenant olive-001 and confirm whether SameSite/secure flags are being rewritten? If so, I'll open a case with Ariba support with the header traces.

Marcus — I pulled captures from our edge logs for tenant olive-001 (capture id: edge-ol-20261113-1108). Summary: the initial Ariba SSO redirect sets a session cookie with SameSite=None; secure=true. During our internal redirector hop the Set-Cookie header is present in the response but our rewrite layer strips the SameSite=None attribute (resulting in a browser rejecting it on subsequent cross-site navigation), and the cookie path is normalized to '/'. That exact behavior will cause the session loss you're seeing.

I've opened a ticket with Ariba support and attached header traces. Case: https://cases.ariba.com/case/AR-987654 (internal ref PRO-4392).

Action items I recommend:
- Temporarily bypass the redirector for the Ariba invite flow for tenant olive-001 (config change on edge) so we can confirm recovery.
- If bypass shows success, coordinate with Ariba to ensure RelayState and SameSite=None are preserved through their swap redirectors.

Laura — can you coordinate the bypass and run a quick smoke test with Olive procurement? I'll keep Ariba on the ticket.

Ben Carter
Platform Ops — Redwood Inference
